intent: Assistant panel with a header, a thread, and a composer. Answers can carry figures, a table, a chart, sources and follow-ups. One piece.
useWhen: An inline assistant beside a workspace
An assistant that answers with figures, a small table or a chart from the data on screen
Showing the steps behind an answer while it works, with Stop
A guided empty state: greeting, page context, suggested questions and recents
A help thread with send and a thinking state
Asking about one part of a screen, like a chart card, with context naming it
A tab of a work panel or Drawer that already has its own title and edge — embedded
An assistant start page whose data is still loading — loading
doNotUseWhen: A short notice after an action — use Toast

messages.note: ChatMessage[] with role user | assistant, content, optional id and timestamp. Type only — not a ChatMessage component. Assistant messages may add parts (ChatPart[], drawn in order under the text: metrics → kit Scorecard sm, table → kit Table sm with footer, chart → kit LineChart area as a sparkline (no Table toggle), sources → footer line, followups → kit Button sm outline pill that sends its text), steps (ChatStep[], collapsed into one "3 steps · 2.4s" row that opens the list), status (streaming | error) and error ({ title, description?, onRetry?, onCopyDetails? }). streaming shows a caret and a Skeleton for parts still coming; error shows a card with a warning icon, a soft primary Retry and an outline Copy details.

itemShape.error: { title: string, description?: string, onRetry?: function, onCopyDetails?: function }?

suggestions.note: Prompts that send their text. Plain strings are kit Buttons sm above the composer. Objects { label, hint?, icon? } are rows (kit LinkList) in the empty state.

context.note: What the next message is about, like the card and period a user asked from. A kit Tag sm above the composer; removable when onRemove is set. The composer input is described by it ("Asking about <label>").

placeholder.note: Default "How can we help you?", or "Available when your data loads" while loading.

greeting.note: Empty state heading, like "Good morning, Ada". Turns on the guided empty state.

intro.note: Empty state line under the greeting: what the assistant can do here. With context, the context Tag moves under it.

recent.note: Recent questions at the foot of the empty state. kit ListView sm. Picking a row runs onSelect, or sends its label through onSend when onSelect is unset, like a suggestion.

recentEmptyLabel.note: Shown under the Recent heading when recent is an empty array.

loading.note: Data the assistant reads is still loading. The guided empty state keeps greeting and intro, shows kit Skeleton rows in place of the suggestions, and disables the composer (Send stays disabled). The section has aria-busy="true". With no placeholder set, the composer reads "Available when your data loads".

isThinking.note: Shows kit ThinkingAnimation in the thread.

thinkingSteps.note: While thinking: a live step list (done check, active Spinner, pending dashed circle, each with a status word for screen readers) in place of ThinkingAnimation.

onStop.note: While thinking: the composer reads "Working…" and Send becomes an outline Stop Button that calls this.

sendAppearance.note: soft when another solid primary shares the view (e.g. a waiting ApprovalCard).

radius.note: lg is the standalone card. none squares the panel and drops the outer block/end borders so Chat can sit flush in a workspace rail.

embedded.note: Inside a host that already has a title, an edge and padding (a work panel tab, a Drawer): no header band, no outer border, no inline insets of its own, and it fills the host height (min 20rem). Suggestions line up with the thread text. title still names the section; status, onClose and menuItems are not shown.

requirements: composer input has an accessible name
with context, the composer input is described by "Asking about <label>"; the Tag remove button is named Remove <label>
Send and Close are named icon-only kit Buttons
step lists are ordered lists; the active step has aria-current=step and each step's status is also in words
an error part is role=alert and names the problem with an icon and a title, not colour alone
the collapsed step row is a Button with aria-expanded that controls the step list

built-in labels (conversation, suggestedPrompts, send, chatContext, chatSuggested, chatRecent, chatStop, chatWorking, chatSteps, chatCopyDetails, retry) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default
embedded keeps the section named by title (aria-label) though the header is hidden
loading sets aria-busy="true" on the section and disables the composer

doNot: Do not put a context Tag outside Chat beside the composer — pass context
Do not invent ChatMessage, ChatInput, ChatHeader, ChatBubble, or ChatAvatar cousins
Do not use Modal for an inline assistant panel
Do not override Chat radius from the host — use radius none for a full-height workspace rail
Do not use product-specific, billing-platform, or copilot wording in copy
Do not hide or restyle the Chat header from the host — use embedded
Do not use embedded for a standalone chat card; it has no title on screen
snippet:
<Chat title="Assistant" messages={messages} onSend={handleSend} isThinking={busy} onClose={close} />

<Chat
  title="Ask"
  messages={[]}
  context={{ label: "Revenue · Last 30 days", onRemove: clearContext }}
  suggestions={["What drove the change?"]}
  onSend={handleSend}
/>

<Chat title="Ask about revenue" embedded messages={messages} suggestions={suggestions} onSend={handleSend} />

<Chat
  greeting="Good morning, Ada"
  intro="Ask about this dashboard."
  suggestions={[{ label: "What drove MRR this period?", hint: "Looks at MRR movements", icon: "TrendingUp" }]}
  recent={recent}
  onSend={handleSend}
/>

<Chat messages={messages} isThinking={busy} thinkingSteps={steps} onStop={stop} onSend={handleSend} />

<Chat title="Billing assistant" embedded loading greeting="Good morning, Maya" intro="Reading Stripe and QuickBooks" onSend={handleSend} />
